title: She told me to add some more color to it.
scene: 老师让他在画上加东西。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did the teacher say about your drawing today?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She told me to add some more color to it.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did you add more color, then?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I added some blue to the sky part.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes! And she told me to show the whole class tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That is a very big deal!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She said that my drawing really pops now.

variations: "add more color" 换 "draw it bigger"；"blue to the sky" 换 "a sun in the corner"。
